description.en: A published MiniMax H3 example demonstrating nike-style product landing page, with its exact source prompt and result video.
description.zh: 公开的 MiniMax H3“Nike 风格产品落地页”案例，包含原始提示词与对应成片。

prompt.original: Create a dynamic product-landing-page UI/UX demo inspired by Nike’s digital language, built around the product in Image 1. Use oversized, bold, italicized sans-serif typography and backgrounds that combine speed-driven light streaks with dark carbon fiber or breathable performance-mesh textures. Show a smooth, fast, powerful scroll through the page, plus high-impact hover interactions with scale-ups and color inversion.
prompt.zh: 围绕图片 1 中的产品，制作一个受 Nike 数字视觉语言启发的动态产品落地页 UI/UX 演示。使用超大、粗体、斜体无衬线字体，背景结合强调速度的光轨与深色碳纤维或透气运动网布纹理。展示流畅、快速、有力量的页面滚动，并加入高冲击力的悬停交互，如放大和颜色反转。

verification.notes: Published by fal as a MiniMax H3 example with the exact prompt and result video visible.
